cases.sentence: Вообще Долли казалось, что она не в ___, а в том духе заботы, который Долли хорошо знала за собой и который находит не без причины и большею частью прикрывает недовольство собою.
cases.explain: «спокойном духе» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Kitty, too, did not come, sending a note that she had a headache. Dolly and Anna dined alone with the children and the English governess. Whether it was that the children were fickle, or that they had acute senses, and felt that Anna was quite different that day from what she had been when they had taken such a fancy to her, that she was not now interested in them—but they had abruptly dropped their play with their aunt, and their love for her, and were quite indifferent that she was going away. Anna was absorbed the whole morning in preparations for her departure. She wrote notes to her Moscow acquaintances, put down her accounts, and packed. Altogether Dolly fancied she was not in a placid state of mind, but in that worried mood, which Dolly knew well with herself, and which does not come without cause, and for the most part covers dissatisfaction with self. After dinner, Anna went up to her room to dress, and Dolly followed her.

cases.sentence: Это очень глупо, но это проходит, – сказала быстро Анна и нагнула покрасневшее лицо к ___, в который она укладывала ночной чепчик и батистовы платки.
cases.explain: «игрушечному мешочку» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: “I? Do you think so? I’m not queer, but I’m nasty. I am like that sometimes. I keep feeling as if I could cry. It’s very stupid, but it’ll pass off,” said Anna quickly, and she bent her flushed face over a tiny bag in which she was packing a nightcap and some cambric handkerchiefs. Her eyes were particularly bright, and were continually swimming with tears. “In the same way I didn’t want to leave Petersburg, and now I don’t want to go away from here.”

cases.sentence: Но, право, право, я не виновата, или виновата немножко, – сказала она, ___ протянув слово «немножко».
cases.explain: «тонким голосом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Yes,” Anna went on. “Do you know why Kitty didn’t come to dinner? She’s jealous of me. I have spoiled … I’ve been the cause of that ball being a torture to her instead of a pleasure. But truly, truly, it’s not my fault, or only my fault a little bit,” she said, daintily drawling the words “a little bit.”

cases.sentence: Уже пред ___ приехал опоздавший Степан Аркадьич, с красным, веселым лицом и запахом вина и сигары.
cases.explain: «самым отъездом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: At the very moment of starting Stepan Arkadyevitch arrived, late, rosy and good-humored, smelling of wine and cigars.

cases.sentence: Чувствительность Анны сообщилась и Долли, и, когда она в ___ обняла золовку, она прошептала:
cases.explain: «последний раз» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Anna’s emotionalism infected Dolly, and when she embraced her sister-in-law for the last time, she whispered: “Remember, Anna, what you’ve done for me—I shall never forget. And remember that I love you, and shall always love you as my dearest friend!”
